# mtncloud_vro_workflow (Data Source)

Provides a MTN Cloud vRO workflow data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_vro_workflow" "example_vro_workflow" {
  name = "Create an AD Computer Object"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the vRealize orchestrator workflow
- `value` (Number) The workflow's value (its ID in the option list); give this or `name`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
